heading: Coloretto
body: A set-building card game for 2-5 players (you + 1-4 AI). Collect chameleon cards by taking rows from the shared tableau, then score 3 colors of your choice positively and the rest negatively. The player with the most points after multiple rounds wins!

heading: How to Play
body:
Each round:
1. On your turn, draw the top card of the deck and place it face-up on any row (max 3 cards per row).
2. OR take an entire row into your collection — then you sit out until the round ends.
3. When the Last Round card appears, every player who hasn't taken a row gets exactly one final turn, then the round ends.
4. Score the round (pick 3 colors to score positively). Your collected cards carry over into the next round.

The deck also contains Joker cards (wild chameleons) and +2 bonus cards.

After all rounds are played, the highest cumulative score wins.

Turn order: the playing order is randomized at the start of the game, so you don't always go first. Round 1 begins with the first player in that random order; each later round begins with the player who took the most cards in the previous round (ties go to the tied player who most recently took a row). The player list at the bottom shows everyone top-to-bottom in the current round's play order.

heading: Scoring
body:
Each color is scored using the point table: 1 card = 1pt, 2 = 3, 3 = 6, 4 = 10, 5 = 15, 6+ = 21.

At the end of each round you select 3 colors to score POSITIVELY. Every other color you collected scores NEGATIVELY (same table).

Collections accumulate across the whole game: cards you take in round 1 are still yours in round 2, so once you hold cards in 4+ colors one of them will count against you.

If you have cards in fewer than 3 colors, all of your colors score positively.

Double chameleon cards count as 2 cards of their color. The Last Round card scores nothing.

Joker cards are wild: at scoring time each joker counts as 1 card of a color you declare (click a joker in the picker to change its color; the best declaration is pre-selected for you).

+2 bonus cards add a flat +2 points each to your score, regardless of color.

heading: Controls
body:
On your turn, choose an action with the Place / Take buttons, then click a row:

- PLACE: draws the top deck card onto the clicked row (if it has room).
- TAKE: collects every card in the clicked row into your hand, then you sit out for the round.

Your collected cards are shown at the bottom of the screen with your score.

AI opponents take their turns automatically after a short delay.

Press ? to toggle this help panel.

heading: Tips
body:
- Double chameleon cards are the most valuable — they count as 2 cards.
- Focus on 3 colors only: every 4th color you collect counts AGAINST you.
- Rows are shared: placing a strong card on a row can give it to your opponents.
- Taking a row early ends your round, but secures the cards.
- A row with cards you already collect is worth more than a row of new colors.
